title: Entity Transport Delay
text: Introduce a delay in propagation of a SimEvents message, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Capacity} sets the capacity and {Output number of entities in block, n} sets the outputs the number of delayed entities present. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: n
ports.summary: Number of delayed entities real scalar

params.name: Capacity
params.values: Specify the capacity of the block inf (default) | scalar

params.name: Output number of entities in block, n
params.values: Outputs the number of delayed entities present in the block off (default) | on
